items.title: ChatGPT Slides lets users create, edit and present decks without leaving ChatGPT
items.excerpt: OpenAI's new ChatGPT Slides turns conversations, uploaded files, outlines or a sample deck into an editable presentation, generating custom images and refining text, visuals and charts, with live team editing and PowerPoint export. Off-list source (no allowed-domain coverage found).

items.title: Human attention is the new old bottleneck. We have to design for it even more.
items.excerpt: Reading Anthropic's Oct 16 study (agents now log six hours for every human hour), the piece argues designers' job shifts to building judgement systems for what deserves human attention.

items.excerpt: Kai Wong: NN/g found synthetic (AI) research captures common responses, so human UX research should concentrate on users' edge cases and bad days.

items.title: DxO ViewPoint 6 introduces AI masking, but maintains that no AI image generation takes place
items.excerpt: DxO's perspective/geometry-correction tool ViewPoint 6 adds AI masking while stressing it does no generative image creation. Off-list (PetaPixel's version is Cloudflare-blocked).

items.title: This weird legal case could change how we think of copyright forever
items.excerpt: A copyright dispute over AI-born 'Italian Brain Rot' characters could have profound effects on how creative work and authorship are protected.

items.title: Dear Art World, We Can Tell When You're Using AI
items.excerpt: Hyperallergic calls out museums, foundations and cultural organizations for relying on generative tools instead of paying writers and creatives. Off-list source.

items.title: Vibecoded clones of SolidWorks and AutoCAD released as open-source
items.excerpt: SolidCraft (parametric 3D modeller) and CADCraft (AutoCAD-style drafting) were built in Rust with AI coding agents and expose their own tools to agents via MCP, testing how far AI-assisted development can take engineering software. Off-list source.

items.title: Neural Concept launches MCP to help AI agents operate commercial CAD tools
items.excerpt: Neural Concept's Model Context Protocol Bridge lets AI agents drive commercial CAD and simulation tools, automating geometry cleanup and meshing steps in product design cycles. Off-list source.
